about: Trental (pentoxifylline) is supplied five times from March to July 2026, by brand name only, for a woman aged 72.
Generic pentoxifylline is supplied three times in the middle of a 14-month history for a man aged 69, with ordinary background medicines before and after.
Imdur (isosorbide mononitrate, a nitrate that also widens blood vessels) is supplied monthly, but it is not one of the listed medicines, so nothing must flag.
